title: Dinosaur holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e03a6e'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q66 45 58 58' stroke='#ffe27a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='63' cy='21' rx='11' ry='13' fill='url(#balloon)'/>

  <ellipse cx='59' cy='16' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='#ffd0e0' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 74 Q10 70 6 82 Q16 80 20 86 Q24 80 30 82 Q27 76 22 74 Z' fill='#4fbf7a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#3fa868'/>
  <rect x='46' y='78' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#3fa868'/>

  <ellipse cx='50.5' cy='92' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#8ee6b0'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='64' rx='18' ry='19' fill='#5fd18a'/>

  <path d='M55 58 Q64 55 61 62' stroke='#4fbf7a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='40' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#5fd18a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='46' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#7fe6a5'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='1.6' fill='#1f6e45'/>
  <path d='M53 49 Q59 52 64 48' stroke='#2f8f5a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='36' r='3.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='36.5' r='2' fill='#1f4b34'/>
  <circle cx='48.7' cy='35.6' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='2.6' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <polygon points='33,27 37,32 30,32' fill='#2f8f5a'/>
  <polygon points='28,34 31,39 25,39' fill='#2f8f5a'/>
  <polygon points='25,42 28,47 22,47' fill='#2f8f5a'/>
</svg>
